name: Entity-SVNWorkflow
description: SVN workflows for VS Code using TortoiseSVN's svn.exe: override update/commit, blame, history and partial pull.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SVN operations are disabled in untrusted workspaces: a working copy can carry svn:externals, hooks-like properties and files that run code or send credentials to other servers.

commands.title: Override and Commit (replace server changes with local)
Record Moved / Deleted Files in SVN...
Resolve All Conflicts in a Repository...
Show Conflicts in the SVN Pane
Clear Stored Credentials of a Repository

svnWorkflow.svnPath.title: svn.exe Path
svnWorkflow.svnPath.markdownDescription: Full path to `svn.exe` from TortoiseSVN's command line client tools, for example `C:\Program Files\TortoiseSVN\bin\svn.exe`. Leave empty to auto-detect. Changes apply immediately. [Browse for svn.exe](command:svnWorkflow.selectSvnPath)

svnWorkflow.commandTimeoutSeconds.title: Command Timeout (seconds)
svnWorkflow.commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for a single svn command.

svnWorkflow.incomingCheckIntervalSeconds.title: Incoming Check Interval (seconds)
svnWorkflow.incomingCheckIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to ask the server which files have incoming changes (`svn status -u`) for every configured repo. `0` disables the periodic check; values from 1 to 29 are treated as 30. Checks also run on startup, after SVN operations and via the refresh button in the SVN view. A repo with an authentication or certificate error is skipped until you refresh manually.

svnWorkflow.overrideTimeoutSeconds.title: Override Command Timeout (seconds)
svnWorkflow.overrideTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for each svn command (revert, update, commit, restore) inside Override and Commit and Restore from Override Backup. Much longer than the normal timeout so a big update is not killed halfway.

svnWorkflow.overrideBackupsToKeep.title: Override Backups to Keep
svnWorkflow.overrideBackupsToKeep.markdownDescription: Override and Commit saves your local files to the extension's storage before it reverts and updates. After a successful commit the newest N of these backups are kept (`0` deletes the backup immediately). Backups of runs that failed are never deleted automatically; use **SVN: Restore from Override Backup**.

svnWorkflow.override.backupMaxAgeDays.title: Override Backup Age Limit (days)
svnWorkflow.override.backupMaxAgeDays.markdownDescription: Override and Commit backups of runs that did not finish are kept until you delete them. At startup you are asked whether to delete those older than this many days (`0` never asks). Backups and shelves contain plain, unencrypted copies of your source files.

svnWorkflow.diff.ignoreWhitespace.description: Default whitespace handling in the compare view (can be changed per view in its toolbar).
svnWorkflow.diff.ignoreWhitespace.title: Compare: Ignore Whitespace

svnWorkflow.diff.ignoreCase.description: Ignore letter case by default in the compare view.
svnWorkflow.diff.ignoreCase.title: Compare: Ignore Case

svnWorkflow.diff.ignoreEol.description: Ignore line ending differences by default in the compare view.
svnWorkflow.diff.ignoreEol.title: Compare: Ignore Line Endings

svnWorkflow.blame.format.title: Blame Annotation Format
svnWorkflow.blame.format.markdownDescription: Text shown in the gutter for each line. Tokens: `{author}`, `{rev}`, `{date}` (YYYY-MM-DD), `{message}` (first line, hover only). Lines changed locally show `uncommitted`.

svnWorkflow.blame.ignoreWhitespace.title: Blame Ignores Whitespace
svnWorkflow.blame.ignoreWhitespace.markdownDescription: Pass `-x -w` to `svn blame` so whitespace-only changes do not take over a line.

enumDescriptions: Offer to record renames/deletes made in the VS Code Explorer as svn move / delete
svnWorkflow.explorerFileOps.markdownDescription: When a versioned file or folder is renamed or deleted in the VS Code Explorer (it becomes missing `!` plus an unversioned file), offer to record it as `svn move` / `svn delete` so history is kept. Use **Record Moved / Deleted Files** for changes made elsewhere.
svnWorkflow.explorerFileOps.title: Explorer Renames and Deletes

svnWorkflow.commit.historySize.title: Commit Message History Size
svnWorkflow.commit.historySize.description: How many recent commit messages the commit dialog remembers (0 disables the history).

svnWorkflow.locks.promptNeedsLock.title: Prompt to Lock svn:needs-lock Files
svnWorkflow.locks.promptNeedsLock.description: When a read-only file with the svn:needs-lock property is opened, offer "Lock to Edit".

svnWorkflow.layout.base.markdownDescription: Project base below the repository root that holds `trunk`, `branches` and `tags` (for example `projects/app`). Empty: detected from the working copy URL, falling back to the repository root. Used by Merge, Create Branch/Tag, Delete and the branch pickers.
svnWorkflow.layout.base.title: Layout: Project Base

svnWorkflow.layout.trunk.markdownDescription: Path of the trunk below the project base.
svnWorkflow.layout.trunk.title: Layout: Trunk Folder

svnWorkflow.layout.branches.markdownDescription: Folder that holds branches, below the project base.
svnWorkflow.layout.branches.title: Layout: Branches Folder

svnWorkflow.layout.tags.markdownDescription: Folder that holds tags, below the project base.
svnWorkflow.layout.tags.title: Layout: Tags Folder

enumDescriptions: Log every svn command with repo, cwd, exit code and duration
Also log stderr and the start of stdout
svnWorkflow.commandLog.verbosity.markdownDescription: What the **SVN Commands** Output channel records. Passwords are always masked. [Show Command Log](command:svnWorkflow.cmdlog.show)
svnWorkflow.commandLog.verbosity.title: Command Log Verbosity

svnWorkflow.diff.contextLines.description: Context lines around each change in exported unified diffs and patches (svn diff uses 3).
svnWorkflow.diff.contextLines.title: Diff Context Lines

svnWorkflow.shelve.mode.description: Shelving backend. auto: svn 1.14's experimental x-shelve when it works, otherwise the extension's patch shelves; native: only svn x-shelve (experimental); patch: always the extension's patch-based shelves (stored in the extension storage).
enumDescriptions: Use native svn shelving when available, fall back to patch shelves.
Only svn x-shelve / x-unshelve (experimental, svn 1.10+ with SVN_EXPERIMENTAL_COMMANDS).
Patch files plus metadata in the extension storage; works with every svn version.
svnWorkflow.shelve.mode.title: Shelving Backend
